name: Lurro Mainnet Desktop Proof
description: Owner-controlled, unaudited, desktop-only technical proof of an immutable project agreement and a one-USDC milestone payment on Arc Mainnet. This draft is for owner review, not authorization to deploy or move funds.

scopes.title: Agreement-to-settlement desktop proof
scopes.scope: Demonstrate the Lurro desktop lifecycle on Arc Mainnet: every named party reviews and accepts the exact agreement; the funder deposits one USDC; the milestone is fully reserved; the named recipient submits technical evidence; the verifier reviews it; payout occurs only after the unchanged challenge/arbitration rules authorize it. Evidence must include the vault address, transaction hashes, and desktop screenshots of agreement, funding, evidence review, and settlement. This is a technical proof operated by the owner, not a claim of independent users, an independent audit, or automatic work verification.
